messages:
maya: spinning up weave18b int4 canary. hitting rare OOMs under multi-turns when max_new_tokens=1024 and batch=3.

leo: can you paste a short log snippet?

maya: `2026-02-15T09:12:03Z worker-21 OOM alloc 1.1G for kv_cache; ctx: prompt_len=3600, batch=3, max_new_tokens=1024, prefetch=true`

harper: pattern: kv growth + prefetch + mid-size batches -> slab fragmentation. frag metric jumps 0.3 -> 0.65.

leo: mitigation to try: batch=1, prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=256, kv_evict_threshold=0.6. also schedule longprompt synthetic (8k tokens) to repro.

maya: applied canary payload `{"model":"weave18b-int4","batch":1,"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":256,"kv_evict_threshold":0.6}`

ops-bot: deploy started job=deploy-8819 canary=10

maya: after 10 runs no OOMs, p95 latency +40ms, gpu_mem_frag ~0.34.

harper: queue AB eval vs fp16 baseline for QA and codegen subsets. if quality delta >2% on critical tests, pause.

leo: add automated soft-fallback: if frag>0.55 -> reduce max_new_tokens to 128 and route to weave-small or fp16. alert on >2 OOMs in 10m.

maya: created ticket INF-5511 with runbook link. rolling to 5% now, windows=30m.

harper: note for later: when we re-enable prefetch, use slab_align_pad=256k to reduce small alloc churn.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy finished job=deploy-8819 state=completed canary=healthy
